subject: PO issuance trace + spend cap mismatch — GreenRidge onboarding
messages:
From: Luis Fernandes <luis.fernandes@greenridge.tech>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@greenridge.tech>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: PO number received but lines & cap not matching

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the call earlier. We just received a PO number from Redwood (PO: RDW-2027-3927) but when we crosschecked against our onboarding form and contract the spend cap and line-item quantities don't line up. Quick summary: 
- Contracted spend cap: $95,000 (quarterly) per SOW
- PO issued: RDW-2027-3927 for $120,000 (total)
- Line items in the CSV attached show 3 SKUs with quantities that appear duplicated (lines 2 & 3 look like repeats)

Can someone from procurement confirm the intended cap and whether the PO should be split into provisional token + remainder? We need to get the correct PO to our billing system to avoid hold on shipments.

Attaching our intake form and the CSV export from our invoicing system.

Thanks,
Luis Fernandes
Vendor Enablement Lead
GreenRidge Systems

Attachments: greenridge-onboard-form.pdf, po-line-items-20270414.csv

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Luis Fernandes <luis.fernandes@greenridge.tech>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number received but lines & cap not matching

Hi Luis — thanks for the fast flag and for attaching the files. I pulled the issuing record from our PO registry:
- PO: RDW-2027-3927 (issued 2027-04-13 18:22 UTC)
- Issued by: Procurement -> provisional allocation path (auto-stub)
- Linked cap: none (system defaulted to full-amount issuance)

Looks like the platform that generated the PO picked up the total committed figure instead of applying the quarterly spend cap. Monica / Marcus — can you confirm whether this should be: 
A) Split into provisional PO RDW-2027-3927-A ($95,000 quarterly cap) + RDW-2027-3927-B (remaining buffer), or
B) Re-issue a corrected PO that matches the SOW cap?

Luis — we won't ship anything until you confirm the corrected PO. I'll hold with legal/finance on releasing invoices until we align.

Hannah
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

--- Original attachments preserved ---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number received but lines & cap not matching

Hannah / Marcus — quick read: the onboarding intake for GreenRidge shows an approved quarterly cap of $95,000 under SOW GR-391, signed 2027-03-29. The PO generator is known to sometimes stamp the contract "total" when the intake form leaves the billing cadence blank. Action items: 
- I'll open a correction ticket to the PO registry to request split issuance (provisional + buffer). Ticket ID: PO-CORR-7741 (link in Drive).
- Marcus — finance: confirm whether we can accept a provisional PO for $95k and follow with a PO-B for the remainder as a contingent spend bucket. If finance needs the vendor to resend forms with explicit cadence, I'll ask GreenRidge.

Monica
Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Apr 15, 2027 at 09:03 AM, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Monica — I can accept a provisional PO for $95k from an accounting controls perspective provided we capture the contingency in our ledger and tag the second PO as "buffer - non-billable until approval." Can you please confirm the correct SKU counts before we split?
>
> Marcus
> Director, Finance (Contracts)

From: Luis Fernandes <luis.fernandes@greenridge.tech>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number received but lines & cap not matching

Hi Monica / Hannah — thanks. I pulled the CSV with original SKU mapping and the duplicate line was caused by our intake export. Confirmed canonical SKUs and quantities below (please use these when you re-issue):
- SKU GR-API-STD | Qty: 3 | Unit price: $12,000
- SKU GR-EMB-01 | Qty: 1 | Unit price: $8,000
- SKU GR-SUPPORT | Qty: 1 | Unit price: $5,000

Total per quarter at these quantities = $95,000. We are happy to accept a provisional PO for the $95k quarterly cap (RDW-2027-3927-A) and a secondary buffer PO for the remaining amount if Redwood requires it.

Please let us know if you need the intake form resubmitted (I attached the corrected CSV).

Best,
Luis

Attachments: po-line-items-20270416-corrected.csv

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Luis Fernandes <luis.fernandes@greenridge.tech>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO number received but lines & cap not matching

Team — closing note and next steps: 
- Monica: PO-CORR-7741 created; procurement will request re-issuance as two POs. Proposed naming: RDW-2027-3927-A (provisional) = $95,000; RDW-2027-3927-B (buffer) = $25,000.
- Marcus: finance approves provisional acceptance and will tag PO-B as "contingent buffer — non-billable until activated."
- Luis: thanks for the corrected CSV; procurement will confirm in the ticket once POs are re-issued and send a DocuSign link if we need a signature amendment.

Planned timeline: re-issue within 48 business hours after ticket closure (target: Tue 2027-04-20 COB).

If anyone sees a reason we cannot follow the above, flag now. Otherwise I'll mark this as "actioned" once PO-CORR-7741 transitions to resolved.

Thanks all — Hannah

[Thread status: action required -> procurement ticket open; awaiting PO re-issuance]
